bug_semantics: Cardboard's public Bukkit World unloadChunk overloads funnel caller-controlled chunk coordinates into unloadChunk0. The vulnerable implementation obtains the NMS WorldChunk, requests an unload, drains queued chunk-manager tasks, and reports the result without first rejecting a chunk that is loaded/in use and without handling a null chunk reference. Thus an unload can be attempted while the chunk is active or unavailable; the first-party fix describes the resulting risk as server crashes, data corruption, and potential remote-code-execution vectors, while the advisory's scored impact is network-reachable high availability impact.
flaw_origin: Human-authored direct commit 11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13 replaced unloadChunk0's harmless TODO/return-false stub with the unchecked nms.getChunk -> unloadChunkRequest -> executeQueuedTasks sequence in src/main/java/org/cardboardpowered/impl/world/WorldImpl.java. Later release-port commit 90055a82dbcd1ac2f2f771f7372595eee471c9e4 reintroduced the same body after a source rewrite, but it did not first create the flawed mechanism.
ai_marker: absent — the exact BIC object (`git cat-file commit 11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13`) has author Isaiah <isaiahpatton1@gmail.com>, committer Isaiah <isaiahpatton1@gmail.com>, and message `Fix blank World getEntities in 1.17`; it has no Co-Authored-By trailer, Generated-with trailer, bot identity, AI tool name, or other AI-attribution marker.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mr52-gcmh-9959 identifies CVE-2026-24794, WorldImpl.java, and `cardboard: before 1.21.4`; first-party PR https://github.com/CardboardPowered/cardboard/pull/506 identifies the missing in-use and null checks. First-party BIC page https://github.com/CardboardPowered/cardboard/commit/11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13 shows parent 1c3a2061e0a4b9e1d09d87281a9babdd5fcdfed7 and the exact WorldImpl.java change. Local `git log -L` and global `git log -G 'unloadChunkRequest\s*\(x,\s*z\)' -- '*.java'` trace the mechanism to 11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13; the latter also exposes later version-port reintroduction 90055a82dbcd1ac2f2f771f7372595eee471c9e4 rather than mistaking it for the origin. At the BIC, src/main/java/org/cardboardpowered/impl/world/WorldImpl.java lines 1893-1904 route all unloadChunk overloads to unloadChunk0, and lines 1907-1914 newly call nms.getChunk, unloadChunkRequest, executeQueuedTasks, and return the loaded-state result without either guard. Direct-parent tree verification (`git show 1c3a2061e0a4b9e1d09d87281a9babdd5fcdfed7:src/main/java/org/cardboardpowered/impl/world/WorldImpl.java` plus `git grep -F 'unloadChunkRequest(x, z)' 1c3a2061e0a4b9e1d09d87281a9babdd5fcdfed7 -- .../WorldImpl.java`) shows only `// TODO; return false` and no vulnerable call (grep has no match). `gradle.properties` at the BIC declares minecraft_version=1.17.1 and mod_version=1.17. With no repository tags (`git tag --list` is empty), versioned first-party branch tips provide the boundary check: origin/ver/1.18.2, ver/1.19.2, ver/1.19.4, ver/1.20, ver/1.20.4, ver/1.20.6, and ver/1.21 all contain the unchecked `unloadChunkRequest(x, z)` body, while their gradle.properties files identify versions 1.18.2 through 1.21/1.21.1. First-party fix https://github.com/CardboardPowered/cardboard/commit/f78fc7f35e0f83f2e3618aa06f3cae8532927abf has parent 979d2d38aeb64b01241735d73d26408c5ab88f83; parent grep finds the unload request but neither guard, whereas the fix adds `if (isChunkInUse(x, z)) return false` at WorldImpl.java:2035 and `if (chunk == null) return true` at lines 2040-2042. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13 f78fc7f35e0f83f2e3618aa06f3cae8532927abf` succeeds. `git branch -r --contains f78fc7f35e0f83f2e3618aa06f3cae8532927abf` includes origin/ver/1.21.4 and every later supported version branch but not ver/1.21 or older; merge 60d12f9e19f8b8437afab3407d75cc297337b362 carries the direct fix onto ver/1.21.4 as src/main/java/org/cardboardpowered/impl/world/CraftWorld.java, whose branch tip has the in-use guard at line 2030 and gradle.properties declares minecraft_version/mod_version 1.21.4. Exact BIC-object attribution was inspected only from 11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13 and contains no AI marker.
reasoning: The vulnerability-first path begins at the three public unloadChunk entry points and ends in unloadChunk0's unconditional chunk lookup, unload request, and queued-task execution. PR #506 directly identifies the two missing preconditions and commit f78fc7f35e0f83f2e3618aa06f3cae8532927abf reverses them with an in-use rejection and null handling. History search avoids blaming the large 2023 version-port commit: 11bb18aeec467e32f6bb8ae4ce04c4fa9a081d13 is the earliest repository commit that actually writes this unchecked body, is an ordinary single-parent three-file commit rather than a merge/squash aggregate, and its immediate parent demonstrably retains only a no-op stub. Its 1.17.1 version declaration precedes every vulnerable versioned branch examined; the direct fix is an ancestor of the 1.21.4 branch and later branches, matching the advisory's `before 1.21.4` boundary. Because the BIC's raw commit object names only the human author/committer Isaiah and carries no AI authorship/co-authorship/generation marker, the BIC-only attribution rule requires NOT_AI regardless of any later code or fix provenance.
